title: ⚡ Bolt: [performance] Replace Supabase wildcard selections with explicit columns
body:
💡 **What**: Replaced `.select('*')` with explicit column selections in two Supabase queries (`loyalty/points/route.ts` and `vtu/transactions/route.ts`).
🎯 **Why**: Using `.select('*')` in Supabase queries, especially those fetching lists or paginated data, causes overfetching of full rows. This leads to unnecessary database query planning overhead and increased payload size over the network.
📊 **Impact**: Reduces network bandwidth usage and database load by explicitly requesting only the necessary columns, preventing future schema additions (like large text/JSONB columns) from unnecessarily degrading query performance.
🔬 **Measurement**: Verify by inspecting the network payload size in the browser developer tools when loading loyalty points and VTU transaction history pages, or by comparing query execution times in the database metrics.
